package_check_scope: Metadata, links and bytes only; not a Lean proof or physical experiment.

modules.result: Hamilton algebra, unit-quaternion group, pure-vector norm and distance preservation.
modules.assumptions: Real quaternions and unit norm; conjugation action on pure vectors.
modules.limitations: No SU(2)/SO(3) topological covering or physical optical gate realization.

modules.result: Ideal two-mode intensity conservation, linearity, inverses and phase routing.
modules.assumptions: Coherent lossless complex amplitudes and stipulated sign/phase maps.
modules.limitations: No zero physical control-energy claim, fabricated chirality, loss or shot-noise model.

modules.result: Bounded count weight n/N, strict-subthreshold invariance and finite-dose saturation.
modules.assumptions: Positive capacity and threshold; discrete saturating count steps.
modules.limitations: No Arrhenius barrier, thermal stability, LLG or real nanotrack certification.

modules.result: Normalized spin populations, geometric pumping residual, readout contrast and coherent pi map.
modules.assumptions: Positive branching parameter; ideal population and complex-amplitude models remain distinct.
modules.limitations: No finite-time exact initialization for all parameters or physical NV coherence certification.

modules.result: Clamped rational STDP and ensemble normalization with sum min(S,B).
modules.assumptions: Positive window parameters, bounded weights and nonnegative ensemble budget.
modules.limitations: Clamping may cancel local increments; global normalization may decrease a weight; no tissue safety.

modules.result: Bounded history-dependent conductance, strict spike threshold and spatial attenuation.
modules.assumptions: Positive thresholds, bounded adaptation and attenuation factor strictly between zero and one.
modules.limitations: Spatial decay is not temporal damping; no biological viability or hardware energy balance.

modules.result: Bounded mean momentum transfer with explicit signed optical remainder balance.
modules.assumptions: Scalar rational reservoir and efficiency bounds; clipping at reservoir capacity.
modules.limitations: No discrete spin quantization, depinning threshold or physical MZI-to-nanotrack bridge.

modules.result: Boolean validity folding, exact clipped loss sum and abstract verifier cost.
modules.assumptions: Supplied validity flags and nonnegative scalar losses; unit-cost logical/arithmetic model.
modules.limitations: No SNARK authentication, step-index continuity, measured quantum fidelity or machine O(1).

modules.result: Distinct-point polynomial reconstruction and finite IID with-replacement DAS miss bound.
modules.assumptions: Authentic static shares, distinct interpolation points and independent uniform sampling.
modules.limitations: No adaptive-withholding defense, KZG authentication, production RS decoder or quantum-state transport.

modules.result: Ideal Bell projections, branch probabilities, exact Pauli correction and reduced states.
modules.assumptions: Ideal EPR pair and correct classical outcome; logical release metadata.
modules.limitations: No physical NV availability or authenticated certificate; absent classical outcome gives maximally mixed receiver.

modules.result: Ideal four-qubit swapping and conditional binary-phase filtering recurrence.
modules.assumptions: Complete ideal Bell measurement; independent binary phase labels for the simplified filter.
modules.limitations: No full BBPSSW/Deutsch or physical repeater; strict improvement requires 1/2 < F < 1.

modules.result: One logical qubit, commuting Steane checks, projective distance 3 and canonical single X/Z/Y recovery.
modules.assumptions: Fixed GF(2) matrix, phase-aware complex actions and ideal matching-syndrome checks.
modules.limitations: Global Pauli phases excluded from distance; no general CPTP recovery or noisy fault-tolerant circuit.
